description: Android Activity class demonstrating lifecycle callback methods, status tracking, and navigation to other activities.

classes.name: ActivityA
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating lifecycle callbacks and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and updates status tracker.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Updates status tracker when activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Updates status tracker when activity is restarted.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates status tracker when activity gains focus.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Updates status tracker when activity loses focus.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Updates status tracker when activity is no longer visible.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Clears status tracker when activity is destroyed.
